name: museum-of-me-vnext
description: Museum of Me — The Reliquary of Iterative Becoming vNext. A persistent first-person Three.js museum in active development.

scripts.build: npm run build:collection && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build:collection && vite build --config vite.standalone.config.ts && node scripts/build-standalone.mjs
scripts.verify:standalone: node scripts/verify-standalone-offline.mjs && node scripts/standalone-offline-browser.mjs && node scripts/runtime-source-qa.mjs
scripts.gate: npm run build:collection && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:release-tools && npm run validate:mapping && npm run validate:content && npm run validate:privacy && npm run validate:frameloop && npm run validate:hotpaths && npm run validate:assets && npm run validate:exhibits && npm run validate:source-parity && npm run qa && npm run build && npm run check:budgets && npm run verify:dist
